core_principles: Motion is mandatory: Every step must feel alive.
Big & Bold: Controls must be touch-friendly (Kiosk mode).
Neon on Dark: High contrast for low-light event environments.
Flow over Function: The user journey is a single continuous stream.

usage.primary: Main CTAs, Active States, Key Highlights
usage.secondary: Secondary Buttons, Sticker Borders, Info Badges

pages.template_selection: Horizontal scroll or 2x2 grid of large card previews.
pages.camera: Full-viewport layout. 16:9 Camera feed center. Sidebar for recent photos.
pages.decoration: Canvas in center (80vh). Floating bottom bar for stickers.
pages.result: Split view: Left (Photo Strip + GIF loop), Right (QR Code + Actions).

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Setup Theme: Update tailwind.config.js with the neon color palette and add font imports to index.css.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Component Customization: Update Shadcn Button and Card components to match the rounded-full and glassmorphism style defined in 'components' section.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Routing: Set up React Router for the 4 main pages: / (Home/Templates), /capture, /decorate, /result.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Page Construction: Build pages sequentially. Use Framer Motion for page transitions (AnimatePresence).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Features: Implement the specific logic for each page (Mock Camera, Sticker Drag-n-Drop, QR Generation).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖 etc.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
